title: Earlier Forfeitures Set Against a Circle Sweep Pool
content:
## Points an earlier sweep has already taken

Points an earlier sweep has already taken off a Northbeam Circle Membership are set against the pool a fresh
sweep would take, so the same points are not forfeited twice.

1. Where a sweep entry stands in the twenty-four months ending on the handling day and the membership stands
   active, the points already taken are the points swept in that window.
2. Where no sweep entry stands in that window and a sweep entry stands earlier on the ledger, the points
   already taken are the points swept over the whole ledger.
3. Where neither of those holds, no points are treated as already taken, and 0 points are set against the
   pool on this account.

## The windows as figures

| Reading | Sweep entries counted |
|---|---|
| A sweep entry inside the 24 months ending on the handling day, membership active | Those swept in the 24 months ending on the handling day |
| No sweep entry in that window, but one standing earlier on the ledger | Those swept over the whole ledger |
| No sweep entry anywhere on the ledger | None |

## Points of judgement

*A membership standing active with sweeps of 500 points last year and 800 points four years ago.* A sweep
entry stands inside the twenty-four months, so 500 points are set against the pool and the older 800 are not.

*A membership standing lapsed with a sweep of 500 points last year.* Neither of the first two readings is
reached: the first requires the membership to stand active, and the second requires that no sweep entry
stands inside the twenty-four months. Nothing is set against the pool on this account.

*A membership standing lapsed whose only sweep was booked four years ago.* No sweep entry stands inside the
twenty-four months and one stands earlier on the ledger, so the points swept over the whole ledger are set
against the pool, whatever the standing of the membership.

*A membership whose ledger carries no sweep entry at all.* Nothing is set against the pool on this account.
